category_title: Students with visual impairments and no speech who use non-visual communication methods
minimal_context: The student is making choices about the decoration and lighting in the class sensory room.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to make choices about the decoration and lighting for the sensory room.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Alters her facial expression appropriately, showing she enjoys taking part in the drama.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's pick the props first. Look at the iPad to see the choices.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Points to the statement 'None of the above' in her communication book.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try looking at these printed photos of the costumes instead.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Is not able to use the photos or the iPad due to her eyesight, and waits for other suggestions.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We need to make choices about the decoration and lighting for the sensory room.

STUDENT: (Alters her facial expression appropriately, showing she enjoys taking part in the drama.)

TUTOR: Let's pick the props first. Look at the iPad to see the choices.

STUDENT: (Points to the statement 'None of the above' in her communication book.)

TUTOR: Try looking at these printed photos of the costumes instead.

STUDENT: (Is not able to use the photos or the iPad due to her eyesight, and waits for other suggestions.)

task.content: To make choices about the decoration and lighting in the sensory room.

context.environment: class sensory room, which staff members... decorated to look like a spinney
context.materials: costumes and props, sensory room lighting

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When participating in visual story dramatization
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Jane was not able to use the photos or the iPad in the same way as the others due to her eyesight

behavior_patterns.condition: When participating in drama and dressing up
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: She can alter her facial expressions appropriately.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: She has a good sense of humor and enjoys comedy.
